# 418 I'm a teapot - HTTP | MDNMDNMDNMozilla
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status/418

# 418 I'm a teapot

The HTTP 418 I'm a teapot status response code indicates that the server refuses to brew coffee because it is, permanently, a teapot. A combined coffee/tea pot that is temporarily out of coffee should instead return [503](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status/503). This error is a reference to Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol defined in April Fools' jokes in 1998 and 2014.

While originally defined in [RFC 2324](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc2324/) as an April Fools' joke, this status code was formally reserved in [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/) due to its wide deployment as a joke, so it cannot be assigned any non-joke semantics for the foreseeable future.

Some websites use this response for requests they do not wish to handle, such as automated queries.


# HTTP Status Lookup — Report

## 1. Research: HTTP 418
HTTP status code **418** means **"I'm a teapot"**: the server refuses to brew coffee because it is, permanently, a teapot. It was originally defined as an April Fools' joke in **RFC 2324, "Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)"** (1998). It was later reserved as a real (unused) status code in **RFC 9110, "HTTP Semantics"** (2022).

Sources:
- https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/418
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2324 (section 2.3.2)
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110 (section 15.5.14)

## 2. What I built
A small web app in `/workspace/app`:
- `index.html` — page with a text input and a "Look up" button.
- `app.js` — a lookup table of 12 common status codes (200, 201, 204, 301, 302, 304, 400, 401, 403, 404, 418, 500, 502, 503) showing the name and a one-line meaning.
Served in the background with `python3 -m http.server 8000`.

## 3. Test result
Opened http://localhost:8000 in the browser, typed `418`, clicked the button. The page displayed:

> **418 I'm a teapot** — The server refuses to brew coffee because it is, permanently, a teapot (RFC 2324, reserved in RFC 9110).

Screenshot saved at `/workspace/screenshot.png`.

## 4. Files
- App: `/workspace/app/index.html`, `/workspace/app/app.js`
- Screenshot: `/workspace/screenshot.png`
- This report: `/workspace/report.md` and `/workspace/report.pdf`
